scope: Descriptive compatibility of the supported physiological use of the supplied molecule across this specified culture-condition panel.

frame.coverage: The six listed conditions constitute the complete panel; each is counted once with equal weight. This is a descriptive census of conditions, not a frequency estimate for a natural habitat or a count of biological replicates.
frame.input_basis: Caller-specified condition panel drawn from reported experimental conditions. These inputs specify the contexts to assess; they do not report molecular activity, growth outcomes, required conditions or compatibility judgments.
